input.content: Create the published quote-report Routine now. Call soul_write once with definitionMode canonical. Do not ask me to confirm.

tools.name: soul_write
tools.description: Commit one Soul definition. Set definitionMode to canonical for canonical YAML.

arguments.content:
apiVersion: tulipfarm.ai/v1
kind: Routine
metadata:
  id: 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222
  slug: quote-report
  schemaVersion: 1
  authoredVersion: 1
  lifecycle: published
spec:
  owner: operations
  start: Total
  states:
    - name: Total
      type: compute
      input:
        total: 1
      output:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          total:
            type: number
      transition: Report
    - name: Report
      type: compute
      input:
        value: ${states.Total.output.subtotal}
      end: true
